newsitem.title: SPAIN: Lisbon airport cargo traffic up 1.9 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon airport cargo traffic up 1.9 pct in Sept.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Lisbon airport rose 1.9 percent in September to 8,405 tonnes, the Portuguese airports authority ANA said.
The nine month total of 72,542 tonnes is still 0.6 percent below the same period last year.
Passenger numbers at Lisbon were 4.2 percent higher than the same month last year at 672,536, or 4.96 million in the nine month period.
Cargo business at Porto, the country's second biggest air freight airport, was up 3.0 percent in September at 2,061 tonnes taking the accumulated total to 18,295 tonnes, 2.9 percent higher than 1995.
